top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises an original discovery: the Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall effect (Kane, Mele), with the first experimental observation of quantized edge conductance in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp). It has been independently confirmed for about fifteen years, and the trio follows the traceable theory-to-experiment chain. The credit is imperfect (Hasan and Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang fall outside), so the citation must stay on the Z2 classification and the first QSH observation. I rank IceCube second because the diffuse flux is a new observation, though its attribution to two names is unsettled. The lattice clock is third because it is a better measurement with a clean credit and a prospective payoff, and a prize is better than no award.
